name: Offset check 10 min
description: Short profiled run to settle whether the +582 rpm offset from the 13 h runs persists now that drive parameter 02-03 is on communication and firmware 1.1.1 is flashed. Three speed steps at frequencies already verified by hand today (10/20/30 Hz), so rpm_meas can be compared directly against rpm_target. No temperature schedule - the Omron is left alone and the heater is not driven. SP/CHAN3 volt_offset is 5.0 because the slip ring sits on its ~5 V excitation pedestal; measured 2026-08-29 the channel spans 1.8-8.4 V. The old 8.0/0.0 window (-4 to +4 V) clipped more than half of it. Runs before 2026-08-29 were taken with the scope probe's GROUND LEAD DETACHED, which removed the DC reference and is why SP looked like it sat at 0 V and carried no rotation signal - see ticket 0038.
